name: Negation_and_Pairwise_Deconstruction
description: Instead of stating that all three employees mutually share grievances (which strongly triggers 'clique' or 'triangle' matching), this method defines the requirement negatively ('no peaceful relationship') and then constructively via pairs ('all three possible pairs must be documented'). This forces the model to synthesize the graph structure from the pair requirements rather than relying on a holistic keyword.
